DELETE FROM transition_knowledge WHERE source_stack = 'php';
DELETE FROM target_prerequisite
WHERE target_key IN ('go.functions-errors', 'go.interfaces-composition', 'go.http-service', 'go.concurrency-context');
DELETE FROM learning_goal_target WHERE goal_code = 'go.backend' AND goal_version = 'v1';
DELETE FROM learning_target WHERE target_key LIKE 'go.%' AND target_version = 'v1';
DELETE FROM learning_goal_version WHERE goal_code = 'go.backend' AND version = 'v1';
DELETE FROM planner_policy_activation WHERE slot = 'course_planning';
DELETE FROM pedagogy_profile_strategy WHERE profile_code = 'standard' AND profile_version = 1;
DELETE FROM generation_policy_version WHERE code = 'shared' AND version = 1;
DELETE FROM presentation_style_version WHERE code = 'standard' AND version = 1;
DELETE FROM pedagogy_profile_version WHERE code = 'standard' AND version = 1;
DELETE FROM pedagogy_strategy_version
WHERE code IN ('explicit_instruction', 'retrieval_practice', 'prior_knowledge_bridge', 'compare_contrast') AND version = 1;
